problem_type: Reference-key capacity and frame-slot intent in referenceKeys.ts returned the first mode's cap when modeId was omitted, skipped modes inheriting archetype transportTaskKind, and left non-standard frame slot inputKeys out of FRAME_REFERENCE_KEYS, while hasImageEditReferences hardcoded only extras.image
symptom: Sending first+last 2 reference images on external / headless paths without modeId to Seedance 2.5, Wan 3.0, and Wan 3.0 Prime (or with modeId=firstlast to Higgsfield DoP and RunningHub frame models) failed before dispatch with '这个模型最多收 1张图片参考。'.
direct_cause: referenceKeyCapacityDeclarationFor returned on the first mode in archetype.modes (first mode max=1 before firstlast max=2 on shared image_with_roles), modeMatchesTaskKind checked mode.transportTaskKind instead of modeTransportFor, FRAME_REFERENCE_KEYS was a static 10-key table missing archetype-declared frame inputKeys (end_image_url, firstImageUrl, lastImageUrl, frames_first, frames_last), and hasImageEditReferences only inspected extras.image among explicit body keys.
class_root: Deriving model reference capacity and frame-key classification from partial hand-maintained subsets or first-mode-wins iteration instead of projecting over all matching modes and slot declarations in the canonical archetype owner.
affected_population: External Agent / MCP / headless runTask and CatalogGenerationProvider callers sending multi-frame or explicit carrier references without modeId on Seedance 2.5, Wan 3.0, and Wan 3.0 Prime
Models declaring custom frame slot inputKeys such as Higgsfield DoP (end_image_url), RunningHub Veo 3.1 / Kling 3.0 / Wan 2.7 (firstImageUrl / lastImageUrl), MiniMax H3, and Dreamina Seedance 2

external_sources.purpose: Confirms Seedance 2.5 accepts 2 frame images (role first_frame max 1 + role last_frame max 1) in image_with_roles.
Confirms Wan 3.0 and Wan 3.0 Prime accept first_frame + last_frame (2 images) in frame mode and up to 10 reference images in reference mode.
Confirms official ByteDance Seedance specification supports simultaneous first_frame and last_frame image inputs.
Confirms official Alibaba Wanxiang specification accepts first_frame_url + last_frame_url (2 images).

invariants: When modeId is omitted, referenceKeyCapacityDeclarationFor aggregates capacity across all modes matching modeTransportFor(mode, archetype, vendorKey) rather than stopping at the first mode.
Every built-in archetype slot inputKey used exclusively for first_frame or last_frame slots is automatically classified by referenceFrameKindFor without manual table duplication.
hasImageEditReferences recognizes any key classified by classifyReferenceKey instead of hardcoding a single extras.image field.

door_reduction.why_not: All callers already read capacity, frame kind, and key classification from referenceKeys.ts and taskParamsReferences.ts; the fix repairs the canonical owner in place without adding any new door.

generality_proof: Aggregating capacity over all taskKind-matching modes via modeTransportFor and deriving exclusive frame slot inputKeys directly from everyBuiltInArchetype() eliminates the entire class of false max=1 rejections across every existing and future multi-mode archetype, shrinking the full-catalog modeInputRoutes exception list to empty.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Single owner resolving body-key media family, multiImage flag, and maximum count from selected mode or aggregated taskKind modes.
Single owner classifying first_frame and last_frame keys from standard aliases plus exclusive built-in archetype frame slot declarations.
Single pre-spend guard reader checking whether a request carries at least one reference across standard inputs and declared reference carrier keys.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Reads referenceKeyCapacityDeclarationFor and lowerHeadlessReferences (which reads referenceFrameKindFor) for both Engine A and Engine B.
Reads referenceKeyCapacityDeclarationFor for list_models and guard suggestions.
Calls hasImageEditReferences in taskParamsReferences.ts before spend on Engine A and Engine B.

recurrence.reason: Prior fix 94e59b73b threaded modeId for one path while leaving the unselected-mode early return and static FRAME_REFERENCE_KEYS snapshot in referenceKeys.ts.

prevention.invariant: Frame slot inputKeys and mode capacities are derived directly from everyBuiltInArchetype() and modeTransportFor, and full-catalog scan in taskParams.modeInputRoutes.test.ts enforces others === [].
prevention.failure_mode: Any model/mode cell failing capacity or missing input fails taskParams.modeInputRoutes.test.ts immediately with zero exceptions allowed.
prevention.strategy: Derive exclusive frame slot keys from everyBuiltInArchetype() at module load, aggregate capacity across taskKind-matching modes via modeTransportFor, and remove the Higgsfield DoP exception allowlist in taskParams.modeInputRoutes.test.ts.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed first-mode-wins early return, static-only FRAME_REFERENCE_KEYS lookup, hardcoded extras.image check, and the 2-cell Higgsfield DoP known-failure allowlist in the same commit.

migration: Purely permissive for valid 2-frame requests that were previously false-rejected; over-capacity requests above the model's declared maximum continue to be rejected before spend.
residual_risks: Custom user-authored models without an archetypeId or customCapabilityContract continue to use generic key-shape inference as designed.
